name: core-engine
description: Core Engine - BodegaHub: plataforma de comercio electronico distribuido (microservicios NestJS + Supabase + Docker)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @core/api-gateway && npm run build -w @core/identity-service && npm run build -w @core/catalog-service && npm run build -w @core/stores-service && npm run build -w @core/orders-service && npm run build -w @core/logistics-service && npm run build -w @core/commissions-service && npm run build -w @core/finance-service && npm run build -w @core/field-service
scripts.test: npm run test -w @core/shared && npm run test -w @core/api-gateway && npm run test -w @core/orders-service && npm run test -w @core/commissions-service && npm run test -w @core/finance-service
